title: The fixed raw scalar comparison intertwines pullback
statement: For every Λ,k:W→S,G,q∈N,U and f:A→B in Over(W), the explicit additive maps rawModuleAbelianHomMap commute with the module and abelian five-factor raw pullbacks. On abelian coefficients the arrow is upperStarComp(f.left,B.hom,A.hom).inv.app(forget G). No bijectivity of rawModuleAbelianHomMap is assumed or asserted.

source.place: Tags 03FD, 03Q8 and 03D7, natural sections comparison and inverse-image coherence

proof.text: Expand the module-side scalar comparison with rawModuleAbelianHomMap_source_formula. Its coefficient tail remains the inverse derived scalar comparison followed by the forgotten module coefficient and scalar coefficient factors.

Expand the abelian-side pullback with rawModuleAbelianHomMap_target_formula. It has exactly the same concrete source prefix, followed by the image of the scalar coefficient and the abelian coefficient factors.

Apply rawModuleScalar_coefficient_square. Precompose its equality with rawModuleScalarSourcePrefix using congrArg, and compose with the two expansion equalities. This is a complete Lean proof of the original pointwise naturality statement.

lean.statement:
theorem rawModuleAbelianHomMap_naturality
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale) :
    ∀ (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B)
        (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op B)),
        rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A
          ((higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).map f.op z) =
          abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
            (by rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w]) q
            (restrictedOverCoefficient
              ((sheafCompose _
                (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G) B)
            (restrictedOverCoefficient
              ((sheafCompose _
                (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G) A)
            ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left B.hom A.hom
              (Over.w f).symm).inv.app
                ((sheafCompose _
                  (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G))
            U (rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U B z)
